<?xml version="1.0" encoding="UTF-8"?>
<bpmn:definitions xmlns:bpmn="http://www.omg.org/spec/BPMN/20100524/MODEL" xmlns:xsi="http://www.w3.org/2001/XMLSchema-instance" id="Definitions_MarketingCampaign" targetNamespace="http://bpmn.io/schema/bpmn">
  <bpmn:process id="Process_MarketingCampaign" name="Marketing Campaign" isExecutable="false">
    <bpmn:startEvent id="StartEvent_CampaignStart" name="Campaign process started">
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_StartToDefine</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:startEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_DefineObjectives" name="Define campaign objectives and target audience">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_StartToDefine</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_DefineToContent</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CreateContent" name="Create campaign content">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_DefineToContent</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ContentToVisuals</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_DesignVisuals" name="Design visuals">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ContentToVisuals</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_VisualsToChannels</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_SelectChannels" name="Select promotion channels (digital ads, emails, social media posts)">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_VisualsToChannels</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_ChannelsToLaunch</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_LaunchCampaign" name="Launch campaign">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_ChannelsToLaunch</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_LaunchToTrack</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_TrackPerformance" name="Track campaign performance in real time (click-through rates, conversions)">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_LaunchToTrack</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_TrackToCollectLeads</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_CollectLeads" name="Collect generated leads in CRM system">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_TrackToCollectLeads</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_CollectLeadsToFollowUp</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_FollowUpLeads" name="Follow up leads (sales teams)">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_CollectLeadsToFollowUp</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_FollowUpToPeriodEnd</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent id="Event_CampaignPeriodEnded" name="Campaign period ended">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_FollowUpToPeriodEnd</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_PeriodEndToAnalyze</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:intermediateCatchEvent>
    <bpmn:task id="Task_AnalyzePerformance" name="Analyze campaign performance for future optimization">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_PeriodEndToAnalyze</bpmn:incoming>
      <bpmn:outgoing>Flow_AnalyzeToEnd</bpmn:outgoing>
    </bpmn:task>
    <bpmn:endEvent id="EndEvent_CampaignConcluded" name="Campaign concluded">
      <bpmn:incoming>Flow_AnalyzeToEnd</bpmn:incoming>
    </bpmn:endEvent>
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_StartToDefine" sourceRef="StartEvent_CampaignStart" targetRef="Task_DefineObjectives" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_DefineToContent" sourceRef="Task_DefineObjectives" targetRef="Task_CreateContent" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ContentToVisuals" sourceRef="Task_CreateContent" targetRef="Task_DesignVisuals" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_VisualsToChannels" sourceRef="Task_DesignVisuals" targetRef="Task_SelectChannels" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_ChannelsToLaunch" sourceRef="Task_SelectChannels" targetRef="Task_LaunchCampaign" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_LaunchToTrack" sourceRef="Task_LaunchCampaign" targetRef="Task_TrackPerformance" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_TrackToCollectLeads" sourceRef="Task_TrackPerformance" targetRef="Task_CollectLeads" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_CollectLeadsToFollowUp" sourceRef="Task_CollectLeads" targetRef="Task_FollowUpLeads" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_FollowUpToPeriodEnd" sourceRef="Task_FollowUpLeads" targetRef="Event_CampaignPeriodEnded" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_PeriodEndToAnalyze" sourceRef="Event_CampaignPeriodEnded" targetRef="Task_AnalyzePerformance" />
    <bpmn:sequenceFlow id="Flow_AnalyzeToEnd" sourceRef="Task_AnalyzePerformance" targetRef="EndEvent_CampaignConcluded" />
  </bpmn:process>
</bpmn:definitions>
